about: The NPCs on the island (docs/design/03-domain-model.md, NPC). Shared by the server (server/content), which places them and runs their conversations, and the game (src/game/npcs.ts), which draws them. Points are Blender XY metres (three.js x = X, z = -Y); face is the point they look toward when nobody talks to them. mode: private (one player and the NPC), public (private, but the NPC's lines are heard nearby: keep its lines within 140 characters), group (one conversation for everyone who joins, its first member picks the answers). reach is how close a player must stand to start talking (m). barks are called out to passers-by. vehicle is parked beside them for the look of it. What they say is in dialogue/<dialogue>.json. Ids are stable: quests refer to them.
